intro.text: BharatVistaar (“Platform”) is committed to protecting the privacy and security of users. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, disclose, and safeguard your information when you use the BharatVistaar mobile application or website.
By accessing or using BharatVistaar, you agree to the terms of this Privacy Policy.

blocks.text: BharatVistaar is a digital agriculture advisory and information platform developed to provide farmers and agricultural stakeholders with access to crop advisories, weather forecasts, pest alerts, market prices, scheme information, and related services.
The Platform is operated by:

lines: Government of India / State Government / Authorized Entity

blocks.text: We may collect the following types of information:
a) Personal Information

items.text: Does not require user registration
Does not provide login functionality
Does not collect personal information
Does not collect names, phone numbers, email addresses, or identification details
Does not create user accounts
Users can access and use the application without submitting any personal data

blocks.text: b) Agricultural Information

items.text: Crop details
Land information (village/block/district)
Farm size (if provided)
Queries and uploaded crop images

blocks.text: c) Technical Information

items.text: Device type and model
Operating system
App version
IP address
Log data
Usage statistics

blocks.text: d) Location Information

items.text: GPS location (only with user consent)
Approximate location based on district or village

blocks.text: The information collected may be used to:

items.text: Provide personalized crop advisories
Deliver weather-based alerts
Send pest and disease notifications
Share government scheme updates
Improve platform performance and user experience
Respond to user queries
Conduct analytics and research for agricultural improvement

blocks.text: We use the information solely for lawful and legitimate agricultural service purposes.
By registering or using BharatVistaar, users consent to:

items.text: Collection of relevant information
Use of such information for advisory and service delivery
Receiving notifications, alerts, and service-related communications

blocks.text: Users may withdraw certain permissions (such as location access) through device settings.
We do not sell or rent personal information.
Information may be shared with:

items.text: Government departments for policy and agricultural planning purposes
Authorized research institutions
Technical service providers supporting the Platform
Weather, satellite, or market data providers

blocks.text: All sharing is done in compliance with applicable laws and only for official or service-related purposes.

BharatVistaar implements reasonable administrative, technical, and security measures to protect user information from unauthorized access, disclosure, alteration, or destruction. However, no digital platform can guarantee complete security of data transmitted over the internet.
User information will be retained only for as long as necessary to:

items.text: Fulfill service purposes
Comply with legal or regulatory requirements
Support agricultural research and analytics (in anonymized form)

blocks.text: After that, data may be securely deleted or anonymized.
Users may:

items.text: Request correction of inaccurate information
Update their profile details
Request deletion of account (subject to legal requirements)
Withdraw optional permissions such as location access

blocks.text: Requests can be made through the contact details provided below.

The website version of BharatVistaar may use cookies or similar technologies to improve user experience, analyze traffic patterns, and enhance functionality. Users may control cookies through browser settings.

The Platform may contain links to external government or agricultural websites. BharatVistaar is not responsible for the privacy practices or content of such third-party platforms. Users are advised to review respective privacy policies before sharing information.

The Platform is intended for use by farmers and agricultural stakeholders. It is not specifically designed for children under the age of 18. We do not knowingly collect personal information from minors without appropriate consent.
BharatVistaar reserves the right to update this Privacy Policy at any time. Updated versions will be posted on the Platform. Continued use of the Platform constitutes acceptance of any revisions.
This Privacy Policy shall be governed by the laws of India, including applicable provisions under the Information Technology Act, 2000, and related rules.
For questions, concerns, or data-related requests, please contact:

blocks.title: BharatVistaar Data Protection Officer / Support Team
